pattern.short_summary: Instead of describing what they want, the user supplies one or more instances of it, and the system generalizes or inverts those instances into the operative specification.
pattern.definition: Instead of describing what they want, the user supplies one or more instances of it, and the system generalizes or inverts those instances into the operative specification. The supplied artifact is treated as a definition of desired behaviour, not merely as content to draw on. What the system produces from it — a template, a constraint graph, a set of control states, a reusable action — is what governs subsequent generation.
pattern.structural_signature: The input slot accepts finished exemplars; an induction step converts them into a reusable structure (template, constraint set, parameter assignment, recorded macro); that structure, and not the exemplars, is what conditions later runs and what the user can edit. Adding or removing exemplars changes the induced structure.

dimension.category_description: How users, artifacts, examples, parameters, or user-state signals specify intent and shape the system's next behavior.
dimension.classification_boundary: Requires a user-facing specification or adaptive interaction; invisible sensing infrastructure is excluded.
